findings.issue: הַתּוֹרָה is a common noun, not a name; "torá" leaves the lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
Definite qal participle masculine plural is calqued as ungrammatical "los viniendo"; the active plural coming sense remains.
Verbless clause (this = the statute) is a bare noun phrase, so the predication is unclear without a marked copula.

notes: Other tokens match: y dijo, Eleazar, el sacerdote, a varones del ejército, a la guerra, que mandó, Jehová, Moisés.
